native_mechanisms: Nightingales always land first on the unlocked stone bearing the smallest owed letter (repeated linear scan of the unfinalized set to select the minimum tentative distance, no heap).
Threads cast from the tower price each road by what its thief is owed, one direction at a time (directed, per-edge non-negative weight relaxation from the currently locked node).

A locked garden letter is never rebuilt again, and threads reaching nowhere are dropped and thrown away (settled nodes are permanently finalized; failed relaxations and unreachable nodes are simply discarded/left at infinity).
core_technique: Dijkstra's single-source shortest path over a CSR graph, with a static cost-model dispatch between an O(n²+m) array-scan min-extraction variant (with an optional OpenMP min-reduction) and a standard binary-heap O((n+m)log n) variant.
